description: Waveshaper that chops the wave at a point you set and fills the gap with a folded copy, giving a PWM-like effect and a gradual change to the odd and even harmonics

params.text: Sets the level of the folded signal, which is mixed only into the blank spaces the WIDTH control leaves
Rectifies the signal gradually, which produces a double-frequency effect
Changes the DC component of the input signal, which changes the wave the other controls produce
Sets the pulse width of the signal, the point at which the signal is chopped
Attenuates and inverts the OFFSET input before it is added to the OFFSET knob
Attenuates and inverts the WIDTH input before it is added to the WIDTH knob

inputs.text: The signal to be shaped, at audio rate or low frequency, DC included
A control voltage added to the OFFSET setting, scaled by the OFFSET attenuverter
A control voltage added to the WIDTH setting, scaled by the WIDTH attenuverter

outputs.text: The folded signal on its own, which is generated only while WIDTH is above zero
The shaped signal, which can carry a DC component and is best run through a filter when it is audio
